title: iPhone photo, straight from the phone
story: Full-resolution iPhone JPEG with its original EXIF, GPS block and embedded thumbnail.

title: Camera photo re-saved in GIMP
story: A Canon EOS 40D photo that the dataset author shrank in GIMP. Not a camera original, even though the camera's EXIF is still inside.
expect: flagged: GIMP in the Software tag, pixel size differs from EXIF

title: Geotagged phone photo (Nokia 8.3)
story: Real phone photo whose GPS block records the satellite clock.

title: Same phone photo, date edited
story: Capture date moved 3 days earlier with a metadata editor; pixels untouched. The GPS satellite clock still records the true time.
expect: flagged: GPS satellite clock is 3 days off the capture date

title: Real street CCTV (DVR export)
story: Real pedestrian surveillance footage (OpenCV/PETS sample) with a DVR on-screen clock, encoded once.
expect: clock consistent with the file timeline; stays cautious

title: Same CCTV with 8 s removed
story: Eight seconds cut at 0:30 in an editor and the clip re-exported; the picture flows on without a jump.
expect: flagged: on-screen clock skips 8 s at 0:30; re-encoding footprint at the cut

title: Same CCTV with footage looped
story: 0:26–0:34 overwritten with a copy of 0:10–0:18, the classic way to make a person 'disappear'.
expect: flagged: footage repeats, clock runs backwards at 0:26

title: Recorded statement (real speaker)
story: Frontal recording of a speaker reading sentences; lips and sound in sync.

title: Same statement, audio re-laid
story: The sound track was exported and laid back 500 ms late – as when a statement's audio is replaced.
expect: flagged: speech 440 ms behind the lips

title: Same statement, words replaced
story: From 0:15 the speech was replaced by a re-recording at a different pace (same voice); the picture is untouched.
expect: flagged: lips stop matching the speech after about 14 s

title: Real room recording with mains hum
story: Genuine recording made on a 50 Hz power grid; its electrical-network-frequency trace is continuous.

title: Same recording, 3.3 s cut out
story: A sentence removed at 0:24 and the ends joined seamlessly.
expect: hard case: the phone's mains hum is too noisy for phase analysis, so the test abstains

title: Same recording with a 6 s insert
story: Six seconds from a DIFFERENT recording session spliced in at 0:20.
expect: hard case: a noise-floor step at 0:26 is found, but on its own it stays below the threshold

title: Genuine public speech
story: Real speech recording from the Resemblyzer fake-speech demo.

title: AI voice clone of the same speaker
story: Synthetic speech generated with a commercial voice-cloning model (Resemblyzer demo).
expect: flagged: exact digital silence between sentences, typical of TTS output

title: Real recording without mains hum
story: Captured away from the power grid – the ENF test must abstain rather than guess.
expect: no mains hum, so the ENF test abstains
